title: Clinical Resilience and Systems Preparedness Director
description:
Overview
The Clinical Resilience and Preparedness Director is responsible for developing, leading and sustaining the organization's enterprise strategy for managing extended unplanned downtime of critical clinical systems and applications .
This leadership role will ensure the clinical readiness for the organization in the event that Epic or any critical clinical application system goes down and that patient care can continue with minimal disruption. The Clinical Resilience and Preparedness Director will oversee the preparedness, documentation response & recovery and business continuity planning activities for the health system. This leader will work across teams and disciplines, partnering with executive leadership, clinical operations, IT, Epic, Cyber, Risk Management, Compliance, Revenue Cycle, HIM, Marketing and our Community Connect partners to ensure clinical downtime readiness.
Responsibilities

• Partner with executive leadership, clinical operations, IT, Epic, Cyber, Risk Management, Compliance, Revenue Cycle,HIM Marketing and our Community Connect partners

• Ensure clinical downtime readiness in the event of a system outage of major clinical applications, including Epic.

• Establish a readiness strategy for our workforce and Community Connect partners.

• Ensure Clinical Downtime Readiness

• Standardized downtime procedures across all hospitals and ambulatory areas.

• Ensure paper chart packets readily available in all inpatient units, ambulatory offices and procedure areas.

• Oversee downtime procedures including workflows for order entry, positive patient identification, radiology and lab requisitions, admission/discharge/transfer bed management and other clinical care processes

• Ensure safe patient care when core clinical IT systems are unavailable.

• Responsible for the ongoing creation, standardization and revisions of the paper downtime forms.

• Ensure downtime kits containing paper charts and supplies are distributed and maintained in all clinical areas and departments.

• Ensure a minimum of one week of supplies are available across the enterprise for all clinical departments.

• Oversee annual downtime drills for the organization including inpatient units, office and procedural areas.

• Ensure annual competency validation for all clinical and support team members including Physicians, Advanced Practice Providers, Pharmacists, Health Care Techs, Laboratory, Radiology, Cardiology, Emergency Department and procedural team members. All clinical support staff and ancillary departments such as dietary, transport, are to be included.

• Partner with Clinical Education team.

• Create and lead a Clinical Resilience and Preparedness governance committee.

• Identify clinical lead champions from Nursing, Providers, Pharmacy and other clinical areas to participate in drills and support downtime operations.

• Establish a downtime Command Center structure to be utilized during extended system outages.

• Identify and establish plan for access to clinical staff schedules for providers, nurses and other key staff members. Lead annual failover testing with Epic's Publicly Accessible Gateway (PAG) and Isolated Recovery Environment (ICEBOX) in collaboration with team members from IT, Epic, Cyber, Clinical and Community Connect partners.

• Oversee unit simulations and drills.

• Partner with IT, Telecommunications, Marketing and Operational teams

• Ensure a robust communication strategy and plan in the event of a clinical system downtime.

• Applies strong knowledge of healthcare operations, proven communication, problem solving, critical thinking and management skills that promote patient safety and workflow efficiencies for the clinical team members, including our Community Connect partners, during a system downtime process.

• Develop and manage recovery and data reentry procedures after clinical systems have been restored.

title: Senior Brand Manager - Beauty - AMAZON
description:
Senior Brand Manager - Beauty
ABOUT NEATO
Neato is a 2P eCommerce accelerator based in Las Vegas. We buy inventory from established brands and operate as their exclusive online retailer across every major channel - Amazon, TikTok Shop, DTC, and Walmart - all fulfilled from a single inventory pool. Unlike agencies that get paid whether you grow or not, we make money when we sell your product. When we don't, we eat it. Every decision we make is backed by our own capital.
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Senior Brand Manager owns the profit and loss of a beauty portfolio inside that model. You are the one person accountable for contribution margin - the number that says whether the brand is worth Neato 's capital every week. You set the price, protect the buy box, keep the shelves in stock, run the promotional calendar, chase the reimbursements, and answer for the result.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN
✓ Availability - in-stock rate on every ASIN, every day. You set the reorder cadence with Supply Chain and own stockouts before they happen.
✓ Price & margin - every price on every channel. Buy box protection. MAP enforcement. Margin defense when algorithms move against you.
✓ Merchandising, assortment, conversion - detail pages, A+ content, video, imagery, reviews, variations. Anything a shopper sees is your surface.
✓ Profit recovery - billbacks, reimbursements, chargebacks, shortage claims. Money left on the table is money you're accountable for.
✓ Marketplace control - unauthorized sellers, MAP violators, counterfeits. You quarterback the enforcement plan with Legal and the brand.
✓ Demand generation - ad strategy, Vine, PPC, DSP, external traffic. You set the plan; the Ads team executes; you own the ROAS.
✓ Promotion & subscription - promo calendar, deal cadence, Subscribe & Save base growth. Every promo has a P&L before it runs.
✓ Brand partnership - you are the face Neato shows the brand. Weekly reviews, quarterly strategy, joint planning. When the brand escalates, they call you first.
HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED
✓ Portfolio contribution margin - trend and absolute.
✓ In-stock rate - across the assortment.
✓ Buy box ownership rate - on 1P and 3P.
✓ Subscribe & Save base growth - month over month.
✓ Reimbursement dollars recovered - against opportunity.
✓ Brand partner NPS - they renew or they don't.
WHAT YOU BRING
✓ 7-10+ years operating a beauty CPG brand's P&L - direct Amazon 1P and 3P operating experience, not agency-adjacent.
✓ Weekly numbers cadence - you read the P&L to peers every week without notes.
✓ Reimbursement fluency - you know what Amazon owes you and how to collect it.
✓ MAP enforcement experience - across marketplaces.
✓ Contribution-margin literacy - you can defend a promo or a price change to a CFO.
✓ Bias to action - over meetings and decks.
NICE TO HAVE
★ TikTok Shop, DTC, Walmart - hands-on experience, or fast to learn.
WHY YOU'LL WANT THIS
This is a true P&L seat, not a coordination role - you set price, own the promo calendar, and answer directly for contribution margin, with performance-linked upside tied to the result. You partner daily with Supply Chain, Creative, Ads, and Finance, and you're the person the brand calls first when it matters.
Neato · 2026 · Equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Salary: $130k-$170k DOE Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Vice President of Sales
description:
Cross-industry, insurance-first | Global remit | Americas-based, remote | Reports to the Chief Commercial Officer
Who we are
Adlib is the AI Production Layer for regulated industries. We turn complex, unstructured documents into governed, validated, AI-ready data so enterprises can make defensible decisions without rebuilding their stack. Customers see 60% fewer exceptions, 50% faster cycle times and 70% less manual handling.
On top of that trusted data layer sits our agentic intake capability. Agents read the packet, decide what it is, apply the customer’s rules, route the exception and trigger the next action. The document layer establishes trust in the data. The agentic layer acts on it.
For insurance carriers that means agentic intake across FNOL packets, police reports, medical records, adjuster notes, loss runs, submissions and endorsements. We are model-agnostic and system-agnostic by design, sitting in front of Guidewire, Duck Creek, Sapiens and Majesco rather than replacing any of it. We serve life sciences, insurance and public sector customers, and we are backed by Diversis Capital.
The role
This is not a standard VP of Sales job. Insurance is our core growth driver and this role goes deepest there, but it carries the whole company number across life sciences, public sector and OEM as well, worldwide. It also has to absorb sellers and systems from an acquisition, and leave the sales function in a state that stands up to institutional scrutiny.
You will inherit a small, capable team and an open field. We are blending a startup mentality with an established business, so you can innovate faster while deploying proven sales tactics and processes that work. You are building the machine: territory and quota design, capacity planning, methodology, deal inspection, and a forecast the Board can rely on. You report to the Chief Commercial Officer and sit on the commercial leadership team.
You will also sell. At our current team size this is a working leadership role, and you will personally lead the largest opportunities in your first two quarters.

title: VIE - REM - Ingénieur Test & Mise en Service ICC (Montreal, QC, CA)
description:
À la tête des entreprises qui s’engagent vers un avenir plus vert, Alstom développe et commercialise des solutions de mobilité qui apportent les fondements durables pour l’avenir des transports. Notre portefeuille de produits s’étend des trains à grande vitesse, métros, monorails et tramways jusqu’aux systèmes intégrés, services sur mesure, infrastructures, signalisation et solutions de mobilité numérique.

Nous rejoindre, c’est rejoindre une entreprise bienveillante, responsable et innovante où plus de 80 000 personnes ouvrent la voie à une mobilité plus verte et plus intelligente dans le monde entier.

Pourriez-vous être le/la VIE ICC Test and Commissioning Engineer, basé(e) à Montréal, Canada, que nous recherchons ?

Votre futur rôle
Relevez un nouveau défi et développez votre expertise dans les essais et la mise en service de systèmes ferroviaires intégrés.

Au sein de la solution SLV (« Signalling & Low Voltage ») d’ Alstom , l’ATS (« Automatic Train Supervision ») a pour fonction de superviser et réguler la circulation des trains, tandis que le SCADA (« Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition ») permet la gestion de l’énergie de traction, des équipements électromécaniques et de la ventilation en tunnel. En outre, le CSP (« Cybersecurity Platform ») fournit des services de cybersécurité à l'ensemble du système SLV et à d'autres acteurs externes.La combinaison de ces 3 sous-systèmes forme l’entité dénommée « Integrated Control Center » (ICC)..

L’objectif du poste est de contribuer à la préparation et à l’exécution des essais sur site des sous-systèmes ICC, conformément aux exigences contractuelles, à la stratégie du projet et aux politiques de l’entreprise en matière d’EHS, de sécurité ferroviaire et de qualité.

Vous serez rattaché(e) au ICC T&C Manager. Vous collaborerez avec les équipes T&C, installation, ingénierie, support technique, ainsi qu’avec les partenaires et sous-traitants du projet.

Nous ferons appel à vous pour

• Participer à la préparation des activités d’essais et de mise en service des sous-systèmes ICC.

• Contribuer à la rédaction et à la mise à jour des procédures et cahiers d’essais.

• Vérifier la disponibilité et la conformité des prérequis avant le démarrage des essais.

• Exécuter les essais statiques, fonctionnels, d’intégration et de performance.

• Enregistrer les résultats et rédiger les rapports d’essais.

Description
MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.
We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi 's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.
As Staff Product Designer , you will own the end-to-end design of MEDvidi 's AI Track, the core line of AI-powered clinical tools where providers interact with model outputs in a regulated healthcare environment. Your design decisions directly shape how clinicians review, accept, and correct AI-generated notes, treatment plans, and recommendations, impacting both provider efficiency and patient outcomes.
You will work closely with product managers and engineers, reporting to the Director of Product. Your scope includes provider-facing tools (Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist), patient portal, and internal operational systems, all web-based.
Why this role

•
Zero-to-one in AI-first environment. You will shape new interaction patterns for agentic AI features: Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist, where design quality directly affects clinical decisions.

•
Prototype in real code, not Figma mockups. Prototyping happens in Claude Code and Cursor on the actual codebase with production components. Your prototypes go straight to engineering without redrawing.

Co-own a design system built for humans and AI agents. You will evolve reusable components, tokens, and documentation that are readable by both your teammates and code-generation agents, a rare opportunity to define what design systems look like in an AI-native workflow.

Ensure quality of design decisions: validate solutions with users when needed, perform design acceptance with engineering, analyze post-release results, and feed learnings back into the product.

•
Contribute to the design system within product initiatives: turn your solutions into reusable components in Storybook with tokens, naming, and documentation that are usable by both designers and AI code-generation agents.

•
Gather requirements independently: go to providers, medical operations, and product managers, identify problems, and bring back a proposal. There is no standing PM brief in AI Track, you shape the brief.

Accelerate design delivery using AI tools: build functional prototypes in Claude Code or Cursor on the real codebase with production components; prototypes go to engineering without redrawing.

title: Principal, Product Analytics
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Principal, Product Analytics who loves getting to the bottom of things. You'll do the deep investigative and technical work that explains why users and customers behave the way they do, and turn it into decisions that change the product and the business.

We're building a more proactive data function, and this role is its deep-investigation engine. You'll take ambiguous, high-stakes questions about user behaviour and customer experience and follow them wherever the data leads, across acquisition, activation, usage and the wider customer journey.

You'll work hands-on and independently, partnering with Product Managers, engineering managers and commercial teams, and working alongside a VP of Growth who will set the function's direction and build the team. Your findings will inform experiments, the roadmap and company strategy.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Go looking for what nobody asked about. This is the heart of the role. You'll notice when something looks off in a funnel, a cohort or a metric, disappear into it, and come back with a product issue, a cost leak or an opportunity nobody was looking for. You set much of your own agenda, and you don't wait for a request to start digging.

- Lead deep investigations into user behaviour and customer experience across product and non-product touchpoints, including support, customer success and sales.

- Find where activation breaks. Identify failure points in the user journey, including those that could become productised capabilities.

- Understand acquisition and intent. Dig into acquisition channels, user use cases and what people are actually trying to achieve.

- Do rigorous causal and statistical work. Go beyond correlation with regression, causal analysis and well-designed experiments, and be clear about what the evidence does and doesn't support.

- Build models that drive action. Apply data science to real business problems, such as churn modelling that can trigger real-time product action, and explain clearly how models are applied and what impact they have.

- Analyse unstructured and AI-specific data. Work with agent-user conversations, context layers and evaluation systems alongside structured product data.

- Size opportunities. Produce market opportunity sizing that helps the business prioritise.

- Measure how we build. Partner with engineering managers on organisational productivity metrics.

- Communicate for impact. Translate findings into clear recommendations for product teams, management and executives.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

MUST-HAVES

- Deep product analytics experience across growth and broader product areas, with a record of investigations that changed decisions.

- Data science and modelling experience, and the ability to explain how you applied it and what business impact it had.

- Strong grounding in correlation, regression and causal analysis.

- A proactive approach. You surface insights and shape the agenda rather than working to a brief.

- Genuine curiosity. You notice what looks off and dig until you understand why.

- Clear communication with management and executives about business impact, simplifying complex analysis into actionable recommendations.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE?

As a trustworthy and efficient Swisscom IT service partner, we create valuable customer experiences. We work in strong collaboration with our partners in Switzerland and attract and retain high performers.

The team / project
The Mobile Technology & Voice Value Stream is building an AI tooling suite that automates and supports the operation of Swisscom's mobile and voice network. We are a small, collaborative pod working closely with product owners and business stakeholders in Switzerland, network SMEs and external specialists, and together we're building an internal AI delivery capability for Swisscom Operations.

As Agentic AI Engineer, you are a hands-on individual contributor who designs and builds agentic AI tools that automate operational processes. You help shape architecture decisions, engineering standards, code quality and technical delivery, and help embed AI engineering practices within Swisscom.

What you'll do

• Build agentic workflows: Design and implement agent-based and multi-agent workflows that automate Mobile Technology & Voice operational processes.
• Orchestrate the agents: Develop and evolve orchestrator logic and tool-use patterns for operations automation.
• Ship production-grade LLM apps: Build LLM applications on AWS Bedrock with suitable agent frameworks, and define prompt, context, grounding, citation and response-assembly patterns.
• Make it trustworthy: Implement evaluation for quality, groundedness, latency, reliability and safety, plus guardrails against prompt injection, unsupported claims and unsafe tool usage.
• Keep humans in the loop: Design human-in-the-loop controls and evidence-based decision-support outputs.

• Raise the bar: Uphold the pod's engineering, testing, documentation and code-review standards.
• Deliver as a pod: Plan and coordinate delivery with pod members, remove technical blockers, support onboarding, and pair with external specialists so knowledge stays within Swisscom.
• Turn operations into code: Work with Managers on Duty, network SMEs and operations engineers to convert workflows, SOPs and expert judgement into testable agent behaviour, and demo working software to non-technical stakeholders.

Job requirements
Software Engineering

• Strong professional software-engineering background with hands-on delivery responsibility.
• Strong Python skills, with experience designing APIs and distributed services.
• Contribution to technical design, code reviews and engineering quality practices.

Generative & Agentic AI

• Practical experience building production-grade generative AI or LLM applications.
• Experience with agentic workflows, tool calling, retrieval, grounding and evaluation.

Cloud

• Practical AWS experience, ideally including Bedrock, IAM, networking, logging and serverless services.

Soft Skills

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken).
• Ability to work autonomously in a distributed, cross-location product team.
• Ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong ownership mindset combined with a collaborative, pod-first attitude.
• Willingness to share knowledge and support the growth of colleagues.

Nice to have

• AWS Strands SDK or comparable agent frameworks and runtimes
• Telecommunications, network operations, observability or incident-management knowledge
• Operational AI,

AI has made it possible to build almost anything. The constraint on great software is no longer engineering capacity, its judgment about what’s actually worth building. Product Managers at Mixpanel build products that help customers answer that question, and they dig deep into customer problems to answer it themselves.

Mixpanel’s Product Managers operate with high ownership and trust. As a team, we focus on helping every builder, not just the ones with a statistics background, get real answers out of messy product data and make the judgment calls that separate delightful products from bloated ones.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer, Composite Structures is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling development and production flow of Anduril’s critical supply base. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering, quality, supply chain and manufacturing departments as well as directly with suppliers to execute effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals.

We're looking for a talented Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer to own Anduril’s composites supply base, expediting the qualification and implementation of composite structures and components, such as airframe skins, wings and control surfaces, fairings, radomes and motor cases, with our suppliers. You will optimize these designs for quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness from early development through the entire product lifecycle.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own and manage the composites commodity and its subcategories, including carbon and glass fiber reinforced structures, prepreg and wet layup parts, cored/sandwich panels and bonded assemblies, to execute supplier production (NPI to full production) strategies across Anduril’s business lines

• Be a force multiplier for the Supply Chain team and overall commodity strategy, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership, proactivity, technical excellence, creativity, self-direction, and courage

• Vet Suppliers' production capabilities, factory layout, facilities and workforce for inclusion in the Approved Supplier List, including cure equipment (autoclaves, ovens, presses), layup room environmental controls, material storage and out-time tracking, and NDI capability

• Support Supplier Quality Engineers (SQE) in ensuring Suppliers' understanding and adherence to the criteria for part quality set by SQE

• Own bringing up new production tooling & lines at Supplier sites, including layup tools and molds, trim and drill fixtures, bond jigs and automated layup cells, to ensure materials, processes & tools are capable of meeting product performance, quality (criteria set by SQE) and demand requirements

• Own capacity expansion readiness and production ramp-up at Supplier, including cure capacity, rate tooling and skilled layup labor

• Establish and drive process performance and controls (SPC) reviews at Supplier, covering cure cycle records, porosity and NDI results, witness coupon and mechanical test data, and dimensional results

• Partner with Anduril design engineering on design for manufacturability of composite parts, including ply layup and orientation, tooling approach, tolerancing and process selection

• Identify and drive product and process improvements, factory layout optimization at Supplier sites to lower part cost, reduce supply risk, eliminate potential defects, and improve cycle time over the product lifecycle, such as moving from hand layup to automated or out-of-autoclave processes where it makes sense

• Support SQE with root cause task force at Anduril by working in tandem with the Supply Chain team and Suppliers on composite defects such as porosity, voids, delamination and bond-line failures, and be responsible for closing the loop of root cause corrective/preventative actions

title: Utilization Management Nurse RN
description:
Overview
Who We Are
Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform-bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.
Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.
Responsibilities
Ready to make the right call on care, fast, fairly, and by the book?
Why This Role Matters
Every day, members and providers are waiting on a decision that shapes what care happens next. As a Utilization Management Nurse, you’re the clinical expert who gets it right. You’ll review requests against plan language, medical policies, and evidence-based criteria, then deliver timely, compliant determinations that protect both member access and appropriate use of resources. When a case needs a deeper look, you’ll route it to the Medical Director and support appeals with clear, complete clinical summaries. Your documentation keeps us audit-ready under NCQA and URAC standards. When you deliver accurate, on-time decisions, members get the care they need and the organization earns the trust that keeps our programs strong.
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM Pacific Time, with rotating Saturday coverage as required.
What You’ll Actually Do

•
Decide with clinical rigor: Perform medical-necessity reviews and level-of-care determinations using benefit language, plan documents, medical policies, and nationally recognized evidence-based criteria such as MCG (and NCCN as applicable), in line with state and federal requirements.

•
Apply criteria consistently: Hold to policy every time, and when a request doesn’t meet criteria, route it promptly to the Medical Director for secondary clinical review and potential adverse determination per UM policy and accreditation standards.

•
Dig into the documentation: Analyze clinical records for completeness, spot risk and acuity indicators, flag inconsistencies or missing information, and start outreach or escalation right away per UM workflow.

•
Prioritize what can’t wait: Organize your workload around urgency, regulatory and accreditation time frames, and potential member impact, and raise barriers early so determinations stay timely and compliant.

•
Steer care in-network: Confirm eligibility, benefits, authorization requirements, and network status to support benefit-compliant redirection when it’s clinically appropriate.

•
Power the appeals process: Prepare clinical summaries and supporting documentation, coordinate peer-to-peer and Medical Director discussions when indicated, and route cases on time per policy, including Independent Review Organization (IRO) processes when required.

•
Document with precision: Record reviews, rationale, criteria and policy citations, communications, and outcomes accurately and in real time in designated UM systems to support quality oversight, reporting, and audit readiness.

•
Hit the standard: Meet productivity, quality, accuracy, and turnaround-time expectations, take part in calibration and quality activities, and put feedback to work in your daily practice.

•
Protect member privacy: Maintain HIPAA compliance and confidentiality using minimum-necessary standards, and complete required training and annual competencies by their deadlines.

•
Back up the team: Cross-train and provide cross-coverage to keep operations running and service-level commitments met.

Qualifications
What You Bring to Our Team
Education & Experience:

• Current, unrestricted RN license in the United States or a U.S. territory (compact license acceptable where applicable)

• Graduate of an accredited nursing program (ADN or diploma required; BSN preferred)

• Minimum 1-2 years of recent clinical experience in acute care, med-surg, I

title: Clinical Project Manager
description:
Join Clario , a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, as a Clinical Project Manager supporting medical imaging programs in India. You will lead the delivery of clinical trial projects from study start-up through closeout, connecting sponsors, sites and cross-functional teams while maintaining quality, timelines, financial oversight and protocol compliance. This is an opportunity to combine clinical project leadership with work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation and incentives

• Provident fund and medical insurance

• Engaging employee programs and local events

• Modern office spaces and remote work flexibility

What You’ll Be Doing

• Lead clinical study start-up activities, translating study requirements and response assessment criteria into project plans, timelines, milestones, communication plans and study documentation.

• Manage project execution and stakeholder communications, providing timely updates to sponsor representatives, project teams, sites, Business Development and leadership.

• Monitor critical project success factors, resource requirements, risks, data collection activities and overall delivery against agreed project expectations.

• Own key financial activities, including monthly billing, forecasting, scope reviews, amendments, pass-through costs and the project information required to support revenue reporting.

• Maintain strong knowledge of project contracts, study protocols and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), partnering with Quality Assurance to address deviations and communicate protocol updates.

• Lead, train and support cross-functional project teams, establishing clear project expectations and partnering with functional leaders on coaching and development.

• Support Business Development activities through capabilities discussions, sponsor meetings and polished Investigator Meeting presentations.

• Coordinate study closeout and applicable submission activities, ensuring project deliverables are completed appropriately.

• Where applicable, provide people-management support, including setting expectations, coaching, performance management, hiring and onboarding.

What We Look For

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; education in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing or another healthcare field is highly desirable.

• 1-3 years of clinical trials experience within a contract research organization (CRO) or pharmaceutical research environment, preferably in project management.

• Previous project or management experience supporting the clinical development of investigational medicines.

• Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) guidelines and relevant clinical research regulations.

• Medical imaging experience is preferred.

• Experience with common project and business productivity tools, including Microsoft Word and Excel; Microsoft Project experience is preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to organize and lead complex clinical projects while managing timelines, financial activities and multiple stakeholders.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative, professional approach.

• Ability to work effectively with sponsors, investigative sites and cross-functional teams in a quality-focused clinical research environment.

At Clario , a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work-and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

title: French Language Expert (France)
description:
Role Title: French Language Expert (France)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: France, Remote
micro1 is engaging French Language Experts (France) to contribute to a customer’s audio annotation project focused on French as spoken in France. In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. This engagement is ideal for those with extensive experience in language-related fields such as teaching, transcription, editing, translation, or journalism, or any background that demonstrates a deep familiarity with the nuances of French as spoken in France.
Scope of Work

• Listen to and analyze multi-speaker conversational audio samples featuring a range of French dialects and accents from France.

• Tag audio and speaker metadata, including aspects such as audio quality, background noise, dialect, accent, age, and speaking style.

• Edit and correct automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcripts using French spelling, vocabulary, and conventions as used in France.

• Identify and annotate region-specific linguistic features, idioms, slang, and pronunciation patterns such as regional accents and informal speech (e.g., “t’as,” “ouais”).

• Ensure all annotations are accurate, consistent, and align with project guidelines emphasizing French distinctions as used in France.

• Collaborate with project team members through written and verbal channels to clarify guidelines or resolve linguistic ambiguities.

Preferred Qualifications

• Fluent proficiency in French as spoken in France, with a strong command of its regional varieties.

• Background in linguistics, language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or related fields.

• Demonstrated ability to distinguish between French dialects and accents from France (e.g., Parisian, Southern/Marseillais, Alsatian, Breton, Norman, Lyonnais).

• Familiarity with French vocabulary, idioms, slang, and spelling conventions (including verlan, regional expressions, and English influences).

• Meticulous attention to detail and a keen ear for subtle linguistic differences.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity, accuracy, and collaboration.

• Experience in audio annotation or ASR transcript editing is an asset, though not required.

Sie überwachen und optimieren Prozesse im Zusammenhang mit Vertrieb, Finanzen, Gehaltsabrechnung, Versicherungsvertrieb, Kundenerlebnis und anderen Funktionen, um sicherzustellen, dass das Unternehmen reibungslos läuft und zukünftiges Wachstum unterstützt wird. title: Quality Engineer
description:
Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network-combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Quality Engineer to strengthen our quality systems and support rising production volumes across Quartermaster’s SmartMast™ systems and related marine products. This role will help us reduce defects and field returns, lead structured root-cause investigations, and keep our hardware manufacturing and deployment operations audit-ready as we scale globally. The right candidate has strong hands-on experience building practical quality management processes for electromechanical hardware in demanding environments, and can partner effectively across engineering, supply chain, and contract manufacturers to catch issues early and drive continuous improvement.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Develop, maintain, and scale our Quality Management System (QMS), standard operating procedures, and inspection protocols to ensure continuous audit readiness (e.g., ISO 9001 / AS9100 standards).

- Lead structured root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) investigations (8D, 5-Whys, Fishbone) for manufacturing non-conformances, test failures, and field/customer returns.

- Partner with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers during New Product Introduction (NPI) to establish Design for Quality (DFQ), PFMEA, control plans, and incoming/in-process/final acceptance test criteria.

- Track, analyze, and report key quality metrics (yield, defect rates, RMA/field return trends, supplier performance) to drive measurable reductions in defects and hardware rework.

- Collaborate with contract manufacturers and component suppliers on First Article Inspections (FAI), supplier audits, non-conforming material review (MRB), and corrective action follow-through.

QUALIFICATIONS (PREFERRED):

- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Quality Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 3-5+ years of experience in quality engineering for electromechanical hardware, marine electronics, aerospace/defense, or ruggedized outdoor systems.

- Strong command of root-cause analysis and quality tools (CAPA, 8D, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and First Article Inspection).

- Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and suppliers to qualify parts, resolve production defects, and enforce quality standards.

- Familiarity with ISO 9001 or AS9100 quality frameworks and maintaining audit-ready documentation.

- Ability to work independently and communicate clearly across remote engineering teams, field operations, and manufacturing partners.

- ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Six Sigma certification is a plus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

- Flexible working hours, with occasional intensive sprints aligned to production milestones and audits.

- Occasional travel to contract manufacturers, suppliers, or field deployment sites.

- Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

title: Customer Success Manager - General Contractor Customers
description:
The Role
Clearstory is hiring a Customer Success Manager to own a book of general contractor accounts, from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and growth. You will report to the Manager of Customer Success and work as an individual contributor with a mixed book of enterprise and mid-market GCs. Our GC customer base is growing and each CSM already carries 20 to 40 accounts, so we need another owner to work every account well.
If you have run change orders as a PM or PE at a general contractor and want to move into tech, this role is for you.
What You’ll Own

•
A book of GC accounts. You inherit existing accounts and implement newly sold logos. The book ramps through your first year and reaches 1 to 3 million in ARR in year two, depending on lifecycle stage.

•
Retention and forecasting. Keep your accounts live and renewing by working each one to our written standards, without reminders, and forecast renewals for your own accounts.

•
New GC implementations . Lead post-sale implementation and Project Team Training for net new GCs, so project teams are live and receiving change orders and T&M tags in Clearstory .

•
Adoption. Run check-ins and trainings so field and office users keep using the platform and see the impact.

•
Customer success tools. Use business reviews and other customer success tools to drive retention, adoption, and growth in your accounts.

•
Referrals and growth. Ask for referrals at the right moments and find expansion inside the accounts you own, such as new projects, offices, and additional users. Hand both to the account executive, so your accounts lead to new projects, offices, and companies.

•
Work with Product. Work cross-functionally with the Product team, bringing customer feedback into feature request reviews so what we build matches how GCs work.

What This Role Is Not
This is an individual contributor role. It is not a people manager role and it is not pre-sales. We already have written standards for working each account. Your job is to run them well and raise the bar.
About You
You have worked the general contractor side of change orders, so you know how contracts, budgets, and owner billing work, and you can meet a customer’s situation with one you have lived. You run our standards and practices without handholding or reminders, then improve on them. As an individual contributor, you inspire and motivate the team through your own success, as we cheer each other on and learn from each other. Moving from the field is a real shift, and you will manage your time across many accounts while you learn the role.
The Company You’ll Join
Clearstory is digitizing and automating the change order process inside the commercial construction industry.
Just as TurboTax did for tax documents and Expensify did for receipts and expense reports, Clearstory is doing the same for change order communication and log management by building first-of-its-kind, category defining software that is revolutionizing the commercial construction industry.
The construction industry is being transformed fast by technology, but the way companies communicate costs hasn’t evolved in decades and still heavily relies on carbon copy paper, spreadsheets and email to track billions of dollars. These arcane manual processes can take days or weeks and include hours of manual office tasks such as scanning, manually transcribing, and tedious data-entry into spreadsheets.
At Clearstory we are changing that and creating a new category “change order communication,” by intelligently digitizing this age-old process. This leads to an increase in profits, more successful contractor to customer relationships, more transparency into a project’s true cost, and less wasted paper!
We are a venture backed 100% SaaS company with impressive credentials for a company at our stage.

• Blue Chip Clients. We have already landed some of the largest General and Subcontractors in the US and have helped our clients build landmark projects.

• Significant Growth.

title: SDR Manager APAC - Sydney
description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship.

We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge.

CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will build and run Sales Development across Asia-Pacific. You will lead the APAC team and own its strategy: segmentation, org design and investment trade-offs, tied to the global revenue plan.

APAC is not one market. ANZ, India, Southeast Asia, Japan and Korea differ in language, buying norms, deal size and channel mix. Your job is to build one operating system that holds the standard across all of them and adapts where the market requires it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Set the APAC strategy and the plan to deliver it:

- Write the APAC Sales Development strategy: segmentation by country and segment, org design, and where to invest first. Tie it to the global revenue plan and to peer regions.

- Turn it into a plan the team can execute: capacity model, hiring sequence, resourcing, cross-functional dependencies and explicit trade-offs.

Build the team and the leadership bench:

- Hire, onboard and develop SDRs for inbound qualification and outbound pipeline across APAC.

- Spot future leaders early and develop them, so every key seat on the team has a successor.

- Match reps to the countries and segments where they will perform best.

Design and run the operating system:

- Decide which meetings, scorecards and inspection points exist, and why.

- Adapt the system to each market without lowering the bar, and hold the team accountable to it.

- Own leading indicators (activity, connect rate, meetings set, S0 to S1 conversion, pipeline created) and act on them quickly.

Run the economics:

- Model capacity, coverage and cost per pipeline dollar by market and segment.

- Build the business case for headcount and tooling (AI, sequencing, local-language data sources etc).

- Spread investment across countries, teams and plays by expected return. Explain the choice to sales leadership.

Partner across functions and regions:

- Co-own initiatives with RevOps, Enablement and Marketing, including turning APAC's free and open-source users into qualified pipeline.

- Present results and recommendations to global sales leadership.

- Work directly with APAC sales and marketing leaders and with peer regions to settle territories, shared global accounts, time-zone coverage and headcount trades, without needing someone to referee.

Carry the culture:

- Set the culture standard and model it, so the behaviors show up in every rep's daily work.

- Keep one standard across countries and segments, even where local context differs.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Based in Sydney and willing to be office-based 3 days per week

- 8+ years in sales development, including 4+ years leading SDR teams; second-line experience (managing managers) is a strong plus

- 3+ years leading sales development in APAC, across more than one country

- Experience selling developer tools, DevOps or technical SaaS to engineering buyers

- Experience building or scaling an outbound SDR function in a new region

- Experience writing and implementing a regional plan with a ca

title: Business Analyst / Ingeniero Tester QA

The role

As the Associate Director of Global Partnerships , you will own the new business development agenda for the HelloFresh Group, driving high-value, scalable partnerships across our core growth brands: Factor US, HelloFresh US, and global brand opportunities . Based in our Berlin office and reporting to the Sr. Director Partnerships & Sales, this is a senior individual contributor role where your impact is measured by the quality and scale of the deals you bring in generating net new activations.

You will lead the global BD steerco, setting the agenda, building the process, and holding the function accountable for pipeline quality and progress across all markets and brands. Working with dotted-line relationships across local BD stakeholders globally, you will be the senior commercial voice on all net-new partnership opportunities, reporting progress directly to CMO-level stakeholders across the HelloFresh Group.

Alongside core affiliate, Closed-User-Groups and brand-to-brand partnerships, you will play a founding role in establishing Card-Linked Offers (CLO) as a stable, scalable new channel for the HelloFresh Group, building the commercial model, identifying strategic partners, and working cross-functionally to bring it to market.

This role is not about managing the affiliate channel, it is about landing the deals that open new growth frontiers. If you are a commercially driven BD operator who thrives on identifying opportunity at scale, building relationships at senior level, and turning a pipeline into revenue, this is the role for you.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

Business development & deal-making

• Own and deliver quarterly and annual BD net activations targets across the HelloFresh Group brand portfolio, Factor US, HelloFresh US, and global partnerships

• Build and manage a structured, qualified global partnership pipeline from prospecting through to signed agreement and launch, with a focus on high-value, multi-market opportunities

• Develop commercial partnerships with tech-integration platforms (employee benefits, fintech, telecom) where the primary driver is new customer acquisition - own the commercial deal and partner relationship; technical integration is coordinated with Ops/Engineering, not built by this role. 

• Lead outreach strategy end-to-end: sequencing, messaging, qualification frameworks, and tooling (HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo)

• Identify, evaluate, and prioritize high-potential brand partnerships across target verticals, B2B brands, fitness & wellness, fintech, lifestyle, and media

• Negotiate and finalize complex commercial partnership agreements, ensuring terms meet HelloFresh Group's strategic and financial objectives

• Develop and present compelling pitch materials, business cases, and commercial proposals for new partnership categories and global brand opportunities

CLO channel development

• Lead the commercial build-out of Card-Linked Offers (CLO) as a net-new, scalable growth channel for the HelloFresh Group

• Develop the CLO partnership strategy, commercial model, and go-to-market framework in collaboration with Operations, Analytics, and local market teams

• Manage and grow senior-level commercial relationships with CLO partners, acting as the primary point of contact at HelloFresh Group level

• Track channel performance and report on CLO pipeline health and revenue contribution alongside broader BD metrics

Global BD steerco & stakeholder management

• Own and lead the Global BD Steerco, setting agenda, running cadence, building process, and ensuring pipeline coordination across Factor, HelloFresh US, and INTL markets

title: Responsable des opérations et du développement (H/F)
description: Piloter la croissance et les opérations au quotidien À propos de Code Couleur Code Couleur est une société spécialisée dans la production audiovisuelle et la communication, filiale de LF Production (www.lf-prod.com) , société de production audiovisuelle reconnue pour ses reportages, documentaires et programmes réalisés pour de grands diffuseurs nationaux tels que TF1, M6, France Télévisions et Canal+. Nous développons et produisons des contenus audiovisuels, des formats digitaux et des stratégies de communication destinés à la télévision, aux plateformes numériques et aux réseaux sociaux. À travers nos différents projets, nous associons créativité, expertise audiovisuelle et développement digital. Notre ambition : concevoir des contenus à forte valeur ajoutée, développer des audiences et transformer nos productions en véritables opportunités de croissance et de communication. Chez Code couleur à Bagnolet, ce rôle existe pour structurer les processus internes et impulser le développement commercial. Vous pilotez l'ensemble des activités opérationnelles sur site et participez activement à la stratégie de croissance de l'entreprise. Vos missions au quotidien Coordonner les équipes et optimiser les flux de travail pour garantir l'efficacité des projets en cours. Analyser les performances opérationnelles et identifier les axes d'amélioration continue. Développer de nouvelles opportunités commerciales pour élargir le positionnement de la structure sur son marché. Assurer le suivi des partenariats et la relation avec les parties prenantes clés. Ce que nous attendons de vous Vous justifiez d'une expérience significative dans le pilotage opérationnel et le développement stratégique. Votre capacité à fédérer des équipes autour d'objectifs communs et votre rigueur organisationnelle sont des atouts indispensables
